$schema_note: Phase 3C professional analyst benchmark (BENCHMARK-ENGINEER). Superset in scope of the Phase 3B reasoning_questions.json foundation fixture -- scored structurally against tests/benchmark/scoring.py's real ReasoningOrchestrator run, not free-text grading. Each case's `script` (where present) is the case author's best-effort simulation of a plausible-but-imperfect LLM response, including deliberately unhedged causal language in reasoning_traps cases so the orchestrator's own causation_guard is proven to catch it live, not pre-hedged by the author. Cases without a `script` get deterministic-only premise-validation checks (see scoring.py). `dataset` selects which fixture the test runner should use: 'primary' is the real data/demo/sales_data.xlsx (4000 rows, transaction-level); 'primary_daily' is that same file grouped to one row per date (sum of revenue/quantity/cost/profit) -- required because the forecasting tools reject multiple rows sharing one timestamp, so a real forecasting workflow against this dataset needs the date-aggregated view.
